name: BEAN-Rider modular Jetson 10-inch cockpit

hardware.compute: Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit, adaptable to other Jetson carrier boards
hardware.video_interface: Jetson Orin Nano Dev Kit DisplayPort; HDMI display may need DP-to-HDMI adapter
hardware.diagnostics: SAE J1962 16-pin port to active ELM327/STN-compatible USB serial OBD adapter
hardware.power: separate fused ignition-aware regulator and independent low-voltage disconnect; NOT powered from OBD pin 16

printed_parts.purpose: ventilated universal Jetson mount plate with adjustable M3 slots
housing mount tabs; not designed to clamp display glass
USB/OBD cable tie-down away from vehicle diagnostic port

print_reference.material: prototype PETG/ASA with real heat-soak evaluation

phone_projection.current_support: software receiver handoff; compatible receiver hardware not validated

status_notes: Measure screen outer housing and mount locations before making a final-fit enclosure.
Jetson screw pitches differ by board; generic tray slots are not a guaranteed fit.
Vehicle structural retention, power electronics, cabin impact and thermal testing remain unverified.
